description: Write sorted concatenation of all FILE(s) to standard output.

option.name: --batch-size
tip: merge at most NMERGE inputs at once; for more use temp files

option.name: --buffer-size
tip: use SIZE for main memory buffer

option.name: --check
tip: check for sorted input; do not sort
like -c, but do not report first bad line

option.name: --compress-program
tip: compress temporaries with PROG; decompress them with PROG -d

option.name: --debug
tip: annotate the part of the line used to sort, and warn about questionable usage to stderr

option.name: --dictionary-order
tip: consider only blanks and alphanumeric characters

option.name: --field-separator
tip: use SEP instead of non-blank to blank transition

option.name: --files0-from
tip: read input from the files specified by NUL-terminated names in file F; If F is - then read names from standard input

option.name: --general-numeric-sort
tip: compare according to general numerical value

option.name: --human-numeric-sort
tip: compare human readable numbers (e.g., 2K 1G)

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: fold lower case to upper case characters

option.name: --ignore-leading-blanks
tip: ignore leading blanks

option.name: --ignore-nonprinting
tip: consider only printable characters

option.name: --key
tip: sort via a key; KEYDEF gives location and type

option.name: --merge
tip: merge already sorted files; do not sort

option.name: --month-sort
tip: compare (unknown) < 'JAN' < ... < 'DEC'

option.name: --numeric-sort
tip: compare according to string numerical value; see full documentation for supported strings

option.name: --output
tip: write result to FILE instead of standard output

option.name: --parallel
tip: change the number of sorts run concurrently to N

option.name: --random-sort
tip: shuffle, but group identical keys. See shuf(1)

option.name: --random-source
tip: get random bytes from FILE

option.name: --reverse
tip: reverse the result of comparisons

option.name: --sort
tip: sort according to WORD: general-numeric -g, human-numeric -h, month -M, numeric -n, random -R, version -V

option.name: --stable
tip: stabilize sort by disabling last-resort comparison

option.name: --temporary-directory
tip: use DIR for temporaries, not $TMPDIR or /tmp; multiple options specify multiple directories

option.name: --unique
tip: output only the first of lines with equal keys; with -c, check for strict ordering

option.name: --version-sort
tip: natural sort of (version) numbers within text

option.name: --zero-terminated
tip: line delimiter is NUL, not newline

global_option.name: --help
tip: display this help and exit

global_option.name: --version
tip: output version information and exit
